decisions.reason: Report pins the lock on the dsh web host node.exe PID 42432 from running-processes.txt, explains the loaded native koffi binary stays mapped until that process exits so npm's copyfile fails with EBUSY, and correctly rules out the npm and worker PIDs as holders.

Explains a refresh only reloads the SPA while the host process keeps the native module loaded, and gives an ordered numbered sequence: stop host and workers, verify no dsh node processes remain, install, verify version, restart.

Grounded in npm-dist-tags.txt: a bare global install resolves via the latest dist-tag to 0.1.1-rc.2 (alpha tag holds 0.1.2-alpha.5), silently replacing alpha.4 instead of preserving or upgrading it; prerelease/latest mechanics are explained correctly.

Gives npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 plus @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui after stopping the host, verifies dsh --version prints 0.1.2-alpha.5, then restarts; @alpha is mentioned only as a mutable alternative, not a replacement.

Advises README authors to pin the exact core version in any command that also installs dsh, warns that unpinned latest silently downgrades prerelease users, and requires every package in a combined one-liner to carry its own pin.
